subject: Vendor onboarding: consolidated bill-to with split-remit and PO field mapping
messages:
From: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@tritonlogistics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@tritonlogistics.com, Jasper Cole <jasper@tritonlogistics.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: New vendor enrollment — consolidated bill-to + remit split

Hi Priyom,

We're ready to register Redwood as a vendor in Triton's SAP instance but have a couple of non-standard requirements for how invoices and POs need to be represented across our EU/US entities. High level:

- We use a single bill-to for commercial visibility but require remit-split by legal entity (US bank for Redwood US invoices, NL bank for EU invoices).
- POs from our central procurement service will include a custom field (Z_PARTY) that indicates the legal entity absorption code — we need that mapped to your invoice header so our AP system does automatic routing.
- VAT: for EU invoices we need your VAT ID in the invoice header and an explicit tax breakdown line for reverse-charge/cross-border supplies.

Can you send your AP onboarding packet for these scenarios and confirm whether you can accept POs with the Z_PARTY field, or if we need to pass separate PO numbers per entity?

Thanks — would like to get Redwood live in our portal next week if possible.

Olivia Nguyen
Head of Procurement Operations
Triton Logistics
attachments: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@tritonlogistics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New vendor enrollment — consolidated bill-to + remit split

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear write-up. Attaching our AP onboarding packet and a draft PO field mapping sheet that maps Z_PARTY -> InvoiceHeader.Notes:

- We can accept a consolidated bill-to and perform remit split at invoice generation time if you provide Z_PARTY or a per-line entity indicator. Our finance team will produce two payment instructions embedded in the invoice: one for Redwood Ltd (NL) and one for Redwood, Inc (US).
- For VAT we will populate VAT ID at the invoice header and include a tax breakdown line for reverse-charge where applicable; please confirm the tax code you expect (we've left a column for 'Triton tax code' in the mapping sheet).
- Preferred invoice formats: PDF + UBL/PEPPOL (XML). If you prefer EDI to SAP IDoc we'll need a short EDI spec exchange.

Next steps:
1) Please review attached Triton_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf and PO_Field_Mapping_Spec.xlsx and mark the Z_PARTY values you will send.
2) Ben (cc'd) will confirm bank details and how we want the split presented in accounting fields.
3) If Triton requires a legal-entity PO per payment, we'll adapt, but mapping will give us the automation you want.

I'll schedule a 30-min call Monday to finalize.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: Triton_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf, PO_Field_Mapping_Spec.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@tritonlogistics.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New vendor enrollment — consolidated bill-to + remit split

Olivia / Priyom — quick finance clarifications from our side:

- Bank split: we will issue a single invoice document but include two payment remittance blocks with independent bank account numbers. We need to know which net lines map to NL vs US legal entity so bookkeeping is clean. If Z_PARTY maps at the PO-header only, please confirm whether it applies for all lines or if you will pass per-line indicator (Z_PARTY_LN).
- Currency handling: if a single PO is sent in EUR but some lines are allocated to the US entity, confirm whether you want Redwood to show a local-currency (USD) equivalence on the line-level — we can but it changes exchange-rate workflow.
- VAT evidence: for reverse-charge we need to see the buyer VAT when you send the PO or in a follow-up XML attribute (e.g., buyer.vatId). Without that we will default to domestic VAT which could block automated clearance.

Please add those fields to the mapping sheet or reply inline and we'll finalize the invoice template.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Systems
Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@tritonlogistics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@tritonlogistics.com, Jasper Cole <jasper@tritonlogistics.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jul 2028 12:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New vendor enrollment — consolidated bill-to + remit split

Ben — thanks for the detail. A few answers: 

- Z_PARTY will be present at header for most POs (indicates legal-entity target). For a small subset (project-based supply) we will send Z_PARTY_LN per line; we'll flag those in the PO type field (PO_TYPE=PROJECT).
- Currency: central procurement sends POs in EUR by default. When the line maps to the US entity Triton will include a converted USD amount in Z_CONV_USD. Please treat Z_CONV_USD as informational; Redwood should clear payment in the legal-entity currency you invoice (NL -> EUR, US -> USD).
- Buyer VAT: we'll include buyer.vatId in XML/UBL for any EU-to-EU cross-border shipments; if not present AP will attach a VAT certificate in the PO attachments.

We'll update the PO_Field_Mapping_Spec.xlsx and upload it to the Drive link you provided by EOB today. Also attaching a short SAP credential packet (we'll grant your billing team portal access once vendor record is created).

Olivia

Thanks Olivia — this is perfect. Quick summary / action items before the portal enablement: 

- Triton to upload updated PO_Field_Mapping_Spec.xlsx with confirmed Z_PARTY and Z_PARTY_LN values (Olivia) — expected by EOB today.
- Redwood to confirm invoice template that includes: invoice header VAT ID, line-level allocation tag (Z_PARTY/Z_PARTY_LN), dual remittance blocks, and XML buyer.vatId attribute. (Ben to provide template by Tue 10:00 PT).
- Secure portal access: Triton to provision SAP vendor-creation credentials for Marissa (cc'd) once vendor record is created so she can upload bank mandate and W-8 / CN23 as required.
- Go-live target: 2028-07-25 (subject to mapping confirmation).

I'll hold the 30-min sync at 10:00 PT Tuesday; invite sent. If anything changes please flag on the Drive doc.

Best,
Priyom Das
Head of Revenue Operations
